summary: A panel that rises from the bottom edge over a scrim — the phone-sized answer to a Select, a filter or a sort menu.

pairs.dont: Open an anchored Popover or Select menu from a 32-tall trigger on a phone.
pairs.do: Below md (768), open the same choices in a BottomSheet; keep the Popover from md up.
pairs.why: On the Clarion Endpoints page the anchored menus clipped against a 390 viewport and put 32-tall rows under a thumb. The sheet starts where the thumb already is.
pairs.source: Clarion Endpoints mobile — Status, Location and Sort

pairs.dont: Apply each tick live while the sheet is still covering the result.
pairs.do: Collect ticks in a draft and commit on Apply, with the count — "Apply · 2". Clear sits beside it.
pairs.why: The list being filtered is under the scrim, so a live change is one nobody can see. It also matches Select's apply-not-live rule.

pairs.dont: Keep the draft when the sheet is dismissed with the scrim, Escape or the close button.
pairs.do: Treat every way out except Apply as Cancel.
pairs.why: Same rule as Select — a dismissal that half-commits leaves people unsure what is filtered.

pairs.dont: Rely on the handle — or a swipe — as the way to close.
pairs.do: Always draw the close button; the handle only says 'this is a sheet'.
pairs.why: A gesture-only exit cannot be reached by keyboard or switch control, and a drag needs motion that follows the finger, which the motion tokens (fixed durations) do not describe. The sheet does animate: it rises from the bottom edge and drops back, and does neither under prefers-reduced-motion.

pairs.dont: Let the sheet fill the screen.
pairs.do: Cap it (5/6 of the viewport) and scroll the body; leave the page peeking above.
pairs.why: A sheet that covers everything reads as a new screen, and people stop expecting the scrim to take them back.

pairs.dont: Reuse the 28–32 menu rows from the desktop Popover.
pairs.do: Use BottomSheetItem — 48 tall, the whole row a label around the Checkbox or Radio.
pairs.why: Desktop menu rows are sized for a pointer. A thumb needs about 44, and a row that only reacts on its checkbox is a row people miss.

pairs.dont: Put the app's navigation in a bottom sheet.
pairs.do: Use SidebarMobile — the nav full screen — and keep sheets for one decision about the page beneath.
pairs.why: Navigation leaves the page; a sheet is about the page. Mixing them makes Apply and 'go somewhere' look the same.

a11y: Built on Radix Dialog: modal, focus trapped, Escape and a scrim tap close it, focus returns to the trigger.
Give it a visible BottomSheetTitle, or `label` when there is none — never both.
The handle is aria-hidden; it is decoration, not a control.
BottomSheetItem is a <label>, so the whole 48 row toggles the Checkbox or Radio inside it.
